purpose: Teach: 製剤/仏像/床屋/駅伝/あご/観音/水銀/スマイル

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが新製剤のお仕事してらっしゃるのよ
lines.en: Sho, did you know your dad's been working on developing a new drug?
lines.style: Gentle, conversational opening. Soft curiosity in her voice. She's sharing something she's learned, not lecturing. Warm and inviting—pulling him into a moment of connection.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんとお寺の仏像見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw temple statues with Grandpa!
lines.style: Bright, eager burst. Quick attack on the opening syllable. Small voice brimming with excitement. He's offering her a gift of his day, seeking her genuine delight.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが床屋へ行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went to the barber the other day.
lines.style: Observational, gentle rhythm. She's noticing something small and ordinary about his father. Soft pace, like she's thinking aloud—not making a big announcement.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、テレビで駅伝の応援したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I cheered for the relay race on TV!
lines.style: Bursting with pride. Fast-paced, almost breathless. His voice lifts at the end—he's proud of what he watched, proud to tell her. Unguarded joy.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼくも将来、あごひげ生えるかな?
lines.en: Sho, do you think you'll have a beard when you grow up?
lines.style: Playful curiosity with a thread of warmth underneath. She's teasing gently, drawing him into an imagined future. Her voice lifts slightly—she's genuinely wondering aloud with him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんと観音様にお参りしたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I prayed at the Kannon statue with Grandma!
lines.style: Soft reverence mixed with joy. He speaks carefully, honoring what he did. Quick but deliberate pacing. His voice settles on the memory—calm and pleased.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが古い水銀の体温計を捨てたのよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad threw away an old mercury thermometer.
lines.style: Quiet observation, matter-of-fact but not cold. She's noting something practical and ordinary. Even rhythm, no emphasis—just sharing what she noticed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、お父さんの素敵なスマイル大好きだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I really love Dad's smile.
lines.style: Tender and undefended. Soft opening. He means every word without self-consciousness. His voice is small and true—this is something he's sure about.
